method: Official brand pages, live category navigation and published Shopify product data. Image URLs extracted from official HTML, verified by HTTP GET and decoded with Pillow; contact sheet visually inspected. Range is factual; perception, audience reading, positioning, visual description, axis placements and palette are editorial interpretation. Voice lines are newly authored examples, not brand quotations. This is a branding study, not product suitability guidance.

domainCorrections.Sincerely Yours: https://sincerely-yours.com is the official skincare brand, verified through its story and FAQ. The unhyphenated supplied domain was not used.

brands.name: Bubble
brands.audienceEvidence: Current About page says premium skincare should be for everyone; official community page includes teen ambassadors and campus programs. No numeric product age claim assigned.
brands.rangeEvidence: Live bestsellers lists Slam Dunk and Fresh Start; navigation lists cleanser, treatment, moisturizer, SPF, lip, mask, serum, spray, toner and color corrector.
brands.caveat: FAQ SPF statements lag the current collection, so no blanket SPF number is given.

brands.name: Starface
brands.audienceEvidence: Homepage mascot copy and visible-patch self-expression are broad. Youth relevance is editorial, not an exclusive official teen age band. Website/legal participation ages are not product age claims.
brands.rangeEvidence: Official catalogue lists Hydro-Stars, compacts, refills, Star Strips, Star Balm, Star Wash, Star Cream and Star Treatment.
brands.caveat: No generic minimum or maximum product age assigned.

brands.name: BYOMA
brands.audienceEvidence: Official About page addresses accessible barrier care and inclusive community, without an exclusive teenage claim. Youth relevance is editorial.
brands.rangeEvidence: Official navigation includes facial, body, lip and SPF products. Current product data includes Creamy Jelly Cleanser, Moisturising Gel Cream and adult-oriented Sensitive Retinol Oil.
brands.caveat: The range is not a teen-specific assortment; no blanket age suitability asserted.

BYOMA pink Moisturising Gel Cream bottle photographed close up

brands.name: indu
brands.audienceEvidence: Official homepage FAQ identifies teens typically 13–19 while saying others also use the brand; current navigation separates under-15 and over-15 skincare. Age is attributed brand positioning.
brands.rangeEvidence: Homepage leads with Universal, Clarifying, SPF, Colourless, boosters and refills. Live makeup collection still lists customisable pods, wands, mascara, blush and eye products.
brands.caveat: indu.me redirects to weareindu.com. Current focus is skincare, but makeup is still publicly listed.

brands.name: florence by mills
brands.audienceEvidence: Official brand story explicitly describes a brand for Gen Z by Gen Z. No numeric teen band stated.
brands.rangeEvidence: Official current navigation and product JSON include skincare, makeup, fragrance/body mists, hair care and kits.
brands.caveat: This profile covers the beauty brand; adjacent florence fashion or coffee ventures are not merged into the category range.

brands.name: Sincerely Yours
brands.audienceEvidence: Official story and FAQ explicitly say created with teens, for teens; FAQ also identifies tweens. No numeric product age claim assigned.
brands.rangeEvidence: Live all-products collection includes original four essentials plus Clear Intentions toner, Face to Face Time clay mask, Sugarcoat Gloss Balm, travel minis, kits and Cloud Case.
brands.caveat: FAQ still says four products; live collection is the authority for current range. Correct official domain is hyphenated.
